play_reminder.title: A story is waiting
play_reminder.body: {name} has not played today. A short story only takes a few minutes.

time_limit.title: Time limit reached
time_limit.body: {name} played {count} minutes today, the daily limit is {limit}. Play starts again tomorrow.

subscription_expiring.title: Your plan ends soon
subscription_expiring.body: {count, plural, =0 {Your access ends today.} one {Your access ends in # day.} other {Your access ends in # days.}} Manage your subscription to keep {name} playing.

payment_due.title: Payment needed
payment_due.body: A payment is due. Pay now so {name} can keep playing.

bell.label: Notifications
bell.title: Notifications
bell.empty: Nothing new. We will tell you here.
bell.loadError: We could not load your notifications.

prompt.title: Get reminders on this device?
prompt.text: We can show a short message when a plan is ending or a payment is needed. We only ask when you tap the button.
prompt.denied: Reminders are blocked in your browser settings. You still see them in the bell inside the app.
prompt.unsupported: This browser cannot show reminders. You still see them in the bell inside the app.

push.unsupported: Reminders will show while the app is open. This browser cannot send them when it is closed.
push.no_key: Reminders will show while the app is open. Reminders when the app is closed are not set up yet.
push.no_endpoint: Reminders will show while the app is open. Reminders when the app is closed are not available yet on our side.
push.failed: Reminders will show while the app is open. We could not turn on reminders for when the app is closed. Try again later.
push.permission: Reminders will show while the app is open.
